notes.title: EA V1.1.1 - Bugfixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed some doors not having proper collision
- Fixed doors changing colors under some circumstances
- Fixed some z-axis fighting

notes.title: EA V1.0.1.5 - Bugfix
notes.notes:
- Several GUI Fixes for controllers
- Removed Errant text when opening the lore menu with no lore fragments

notes.title: Bugfix - EA V1.0.1.4
notes.notes: - Fixed several issues with controller support

notes.title: Bugfix - EA 1.0.1.3
notes.notes:
- Fixed bug that prevented the tutorial dialogue from proceeding correctly
- Added a toggle to display item names in the Item Drop HUD element (Defaults to on)

notes.title: EA 1.0.0.5 - Small Update
notes.notes:
1.0.0.5 Changelog
- Reworked workbench GUI, the workbench in the testing range has been left as the old version temporarily for comparison.
- Wells now restore 25% Max HP on first use per floor

notes.title: EA 1.0.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Adjusted Knockback for the player to scale better and be more predictable as to where you'll go
- Fixed several text issues in upgrade descriptions
- Fixed a couple upgrades not doing what they're supposed to
- Fixed Utakesh's mirror image sprites being offset vertically
- Fixed the tutorial Boss's door not closing
- Minor behind the scenes adjustments for GUI changes down the road

notes.title: Patch EA 1.0.0.3
notes.notes:
Small patch:
- A basic minimap is now enabled by default, "Mapping Subsystem" can now be crafted twice to upgrade the minimap
- Fixed a crash with a floor 2 boss, Isaac

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.1
notes.notes:
A few small fixes and changes that got by us between the last tested build and release:
- Fixed teleporters crashing occasionally
- Fixed enemy health and healthbars not updating properly
- Fixed config files not updating properly if a specific setting is changed before the first save
- Darkened the outlines on the trial tilesets for walls to increase contrast until the new textures are ready
- Fixed the death animation not playing properly
